notes.text:
Internal String Allocation of Ekādeśa (Minor Structural Artefact)
Step: #187
Sūtra involved: 6.1.88 वृद्धिरेचि.
Issue: The engine's internal parts array ([["rAmO", "prakriti", "rAma"], ["", "sup", "Ow"]]) shows that when performing the ekādeśa, it consumed the suffix completely and appended the new substitute 'au' entirely to the prakṛti base.
Classification: Display/Engine structural artefact. While it yields the correct surface string, an ekādeśa replaces both elements simultaneously (6.1.84).
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-16 — REPEAT of the same point; new observation recorded in S184: here the ekādeśa sits wholly on the stem (rAmO | '') while in 6.1.102 it sits on the suffix — inconsistent side, same cause. Surface right. Low priority.
